law: trusted wording = HAREESH SPOKEN (archive verbatim). Kaul 1923 = PD printed check. plain = deterministic filter(hareesh_spoken). Sanskrit = corpus KSTS 1923 (same edition as GRETIL).

1.hareesh_spoken: through the activity of the great spontaneous immediacy one discovers one's true nature
1.kaul_1923: The real nature is acquired by the firm stay in the pre-eminent sahasa.
1.plain: through the activity of the great spontaneous immediacy one discovers one's true nature

2.hareesh_spoken: through the discovery of that the flow of activities of Consciousness becomes all of a sudden saturated with it
2.kaul_1923: The flow of operations (becomes) all of a sudden saturated, as it were, with the acquisition of that.
2.plain: through the discovery of that the flow of activities of Consciousness becomes all of a sudden saturated with it

3.hareesh_spoken: through breaking open the two casings there is entry into the great emptiness or the Great spaciousness
3.kaul_1923: Entry into the great vacuity results from the bursting open of the two boards.
3.plain: through breaking open the two casings there is entry into the great emptiness or the Great spaciousness

4.hareesh_spoken: through devouring the pair there is abiding in continuous occasionless consciousness
4.kaul_1923: The firm stay in the universal consciousness is brought about by the destruction of the couple.
4.plain: through devouring the pair there is abiding in continuous occasionless consciousness

5.hareesh_spoken: through the lovemaking of the siddhas and yoganese the great celebratory unification arises
5.kaul_1923: The great union arises from the unification of the siddhayoginis.
5.plain: through the lovemaking of the siddhas and yoganese the great celebratory unification arises

6.hareesh_spoken: through completely letting go of the three veils one is established in the nameless state
6.kaul_1923: The inexpressible stage appears on the abandonment of the three veils.
6.plain: through completely letting go of the three veils one is established in the nameless state

7.hareesh_spoken: the resonance exists in all manifestations of the arising and cessation of the four aspects of the word
7.kaul_1923: In all the manifestations of appearance and disappearance of the four forms of utterance, the sound alone glories.
7.plain: the resonance exists in all manifestations of the arising and cessation of the four aspects of the word

8.hareesh_spoken: by savoring the three flavors the Supreme absolute utterly free surges up spontaneously
8.kaul_1923: On the enjoyment of the triple happiness, the unfettered supreme Brahman of the involuntary and sudden appearance (comes to revelation).
8.plain: by savoring the three flavors the Supreme absolute utterly free surges up spontaneously

9.hareesh_spoken: by the playful manifestation of the four goddesses one is permanently established in the state of repose within oneself
9.kaul_1923: Permanence of the immersion in the real self takes place for ever by the full development of the four deities.
9.plain: by the playful manifestation of the four goddesses one is permanently established in the state of repose within oneself

10.hareesh_spoken: through the arising of the flow of the twelve there is the expansion of the great rays of consciousness
10.kaul_1923: The play of the big rays follows the emanation of the twelve currents.
10.plain: through the arising of the flow of the twelve there is the expansion of the great rays of consciousness

11.hareesh_spoken: when the five observances arise there is immersion into the waveless
11.kaul_1923: On the full play of the five functions, the ungraded inspiration takes place.
11.plain: when the five observances arise there is immersion into the waveless

12.hareesh_spoken: through immersion into awakened awareness there is no more connection with virtue or sin
12.kaul_1923: Release from merit and demerit accompanies the inspiration of the great enlightenment.
12.plain: through immersion into awakened awareness there is no more connection with virtue or sin

13.hareesh_spoken: through the power of the inexpressible oral teaching there is the discovery of the Seal of great Wonder through that the Resonance of the Void is known
13.kaul_1923: The attainment of the unity takes place, through the acquisition of the mudra of great wonderment, by virtue of the concentration on the real nature.
13.plain: through the power of the inexpressible oral teaching there is the discovery of the Seal of great Wonder through that the Resonance of the Void is known
